info.title: postgresql-sharp-mcp — database-agnostic PostgreSQL MCP over stdio; the MCP client launches it.
info.description: Database-agnostic PostgreSQL MCP server with live discovery and bounded per-call database selection using Npgsql.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Prefer environment variables to CLI values: arguments can expose secrets. A CLI value overrides its
environment variable except where noted.

options.name: --databases
options.description:
POSTGRES_DATABASES. Database lock: JSON array of 1+ unique physical names
(1..63 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL), with a connection string or targets. Startup then
verifies PostgreSQL grants enforce the lock.

options.name: --require-database-lock
options.description:
POSTGRES_REQUIRE_DATABASE_LOCK=true (default false) also works. Refuse to
start unless a database lock is configured.

options.name: --validate
options.description:
Check each seed connection (and the database lock) and exit; diagnostics and
privilege/TLS warnings on stderr.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Print this help.
Environment only (default; bounds):
POSTGRES_MAX_ROWS 1000; 1..5000          POSTGRES_MAX_RESULT_BYTES 65536; 4096..1048576
POSTGRES_MAX_CELL_CHARS 4096; 1..16384   POSTGRES_MAX_CONCURRENT_CALLS 16; 1..64
POSTGRES_POOL_SIZE 8; 1..32 (targets profiles x pool size must not exceed 256; a connection string is one)
Discover accessible databases with list_databases; select a physical name per call with the tool's
database argument. Optional tool target selects a profile; the default is the profile named primary if it
exists, otherwise the first profile name in ordinal order.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: Same, but POSTGRES_CONNECTION_STRING wins when both are set.
